definitions.explanation: A shop where customers pay by the hour for a seat or booth with free access to a large manga library, drinks, and usually internet terminals. Many stay open all night and are used as cheap overnight lodging.

examples.japanese: {漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}で{三時間|さんじかん}{過|す}ごした。
examples.english: I spent three hours at a manga cafe.

examples.japanese: {終電|しゅうでん}を{逃|のが}して{漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}に{泊|と}まった。
examples.english: I missed the last train and stayed at a manga cafe.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}は、シャワーや{洗濯機|せんたくき}まであるところが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many manga cafes these days even have showers and washing machines.

notes:
{漫画|まんが} + {喫茶|きっさ} (tea-drinking, as in {喫茶店|きっさてん}). Often shortened to {漫喫|まんきつ} in casual speech. Charged by the hour, with {パック}{料金|りょうきん} (block rates) for longer stays.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}に{行|い}く: to go to a manga cafe
- {漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}に{泊|と}まる: to stay overnight at a manga cafe
- {漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}の{個室|こしつ}: a private booth at a manga cafe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ネットカフェ: internet cafe — largely the same business; the name emphasizes the terminals rather than the manga
- {喫茶店|きっさてん}: coffee shop — an ordinary cafe, priced per drink rather than per hour
